caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a light beige or off-white background. The main object is a decorative, fan-shaped ornament rendered in varying shades of brown, with darker brown accents and highlights that suggest wood grain and a carved texture. This ornament consists of a symmetrical, stylized acanthus leaf motif with three large lobed sections on each side, converging at the top into a rounded central segment. Three round holes are present in the ornament: one in the center and one at the bottom of each side, possibly for mounting purposes. Below the main ornament, there is a small, simple line drawing in gray, depicting a similar but less detailed curved, leaf-like shape. The name "Erwin Stängel" is printed in small letters beneath the line drawing. There are a few small brown spots scattered on the background primarily to the right of the ornament.
title: Ornament
